arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Hawkins v. Community Bank of Raymore asks if guarantors qualify as applicants under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act. The lower court ruled against the sides that brought the case. The Supreme Court will review this legal interpretation.

sections.heading: What each side wants

paragraphs: This case defines who receives federal protection from credit discrimination. It determines the scope of the Equal Credit Opportunity Act. It affects how banks treat guarantors in loan agreements.
